about.title: About Me
about.statement: I believe great software starts with thoughtful engineering decisions.
paragraphs: I'm Matheus Reis, a Software Engineer focused on Backend Engineering and Software Architecture.
My journey in programming started in 2021. Since then I've been building applications, APIs, integrations and systems of varying complexity.

Along the way I developed a particular interest in software architecture and System Design. I like understanding how systems work behind the interfaces, how their components communicate and, above all, how to design solutions that are scalable, resilient and sustainable in the long run.

I believe building software goes well beyond writing code. It means making sound architectural decisions, understanding business problems, sharing knowledge and working together to build better solutions.
I also value collaboration and technical leadership. I enjoy taking part in architectural discussions, contributing to engineering decisions, sharing experience and helping teams grow.
I'm currently expanding into AI Engineering, deepening my knowledge of Artificial Intelligence, Large Language Models, RAG, AI Agents and the integration of intelligent systems.

I see the convergence of Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence as a chance to build the next generation of applications: intelligent, integrated systems prepared to solve increasingly complex problems.
My goal is to keep growing as an engineer, connecting architecture, technology and innovation to build software that truly makes a difference.

cxbloom.name: CX Bloom
cxbloom.summary: Omnichannel customer-service platform with AI, where I own the architecture and technical direction.
cxbloom.context: Bloom CX is a customer-service platform that centralizes WhatsApp, email, phone and chat in one place and applies AI to support operations, with features such as customer history, prioritization by context and urgency, automatic tickets and real-time monitoring. It serves businesses with large support operations, in sectors such as e-commerce, telecom, healthcare and finance.
cxbloom.decisions: Event-Driven Architecture combined with Clean Architecture, to keep the product maintainable and its components decoupled as channels and features grow.
cxbloom.contribution: I lead the architectural decisions and act as the technical reference for the product, with full responsibility for its architecture and technical direction. I designed and built the omnichannel communication platform that unifies multiple channels in a single solution, and implemented real-time communication with WebSockets, focused on low latency, reliability and performance.

portoseguro.name: Porto Seguro
portoseguro.summary: Scalable APIs and microservices for a high-demand insurance platform, with asynchronous messaging and serverless.
portoseguro.context: Porto Seguro is a Brazilian insurance group offering auto, home, life, health and travel insurance, plus banking and consortium products. I worked on this account through VILT, starting with the Insper project and later focusing on backend development for Porto Seguro.
portoseguro.decisions: System design and architectural decisions aimed at scalability, resilience and long-term maintainability. RabbitMQ for asynchronous communication, which increases decoupling and reliability between services, and Clean Architecture with SOLID applied consistently to standardize the services.
portoseguro.contribution: From the conception of the Insper project I contributed to both backend and frontend, using AEM and Java. I then focused on backend development for Porto Seguro, designing scalable APIs and microservices in Node.js for high-demand systems. I also worked on performance and scalability through caching, monitoring, security and high availability, and implemented a serverless architecture with AWS Lambda.

nexus.name: ALE Santa Catarina
nexus.summary: Core microservice for courses and access control on an education platform used by large institutions.
nexus.context: Ale is an education platform for schools and course sellers, with a student app, live and recorded classes, virtual classrooms, mock exams and management reports. Its public site lists more than 500 institutions served. I worked on it through Nexus, serving large institutions such as COC Santa Catarina.
nexus.decisions: A modular, scalable architecture in NestJS and TypeScript, applying SOLID principles and good engineering practices.
nexus.contribution: I designed and implemented the core microservice responsible for the course structure and for user access control, aiming at reliability and scalability. I used AWS S3 for efficient, secure file storage supporting a high volume of content, and implemented high-performance data streams for efficient processing as the user base grows.
